The packaged verifier independently re-evaluates the original density and the closed formula at representative shapes.

value.rationale: The arithmetic mean is the center used by the source's standardized anti-concentration functional, yet ordinary statements that the lognormal is right-skewed do not locate where local left-versus-right density dominance reverses. The theorem gives a complete scale-free classification for every positive shape, an unexpectedly simple three-exponential invariant, and an exact phase at one standard deviation. This is a natural structural invariant of the same standardized geometry rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
